messages:
tess: Postmortem follow-up from the resolver-induced routing flaps last night. Short/long action split below — looking for owners + ETAs.

devon: I'll own the short mitigations: reduce sticky-affinity TTL, increase probe frequency for affected regions, and add temporary resolver blacklisting. ETA 24h for deploy.

irene: I'll take the longer-term work: debounce routing weight changes, add deterministic resolver-fallback logic, and a sticky-route audit. Planning design doc this week. ETA 2w.

netbot: alert: eu-north1 DNS SERVFAIL rate spiked to 3.9% at 2026-03-20T22:10Z. Probe RTT 90p increased by 220ms.

tess: Action matrix (short | long | owner | ETA):
- "reduce affinity TTL to 30s (eu-north1)" | "refactor affinity to consider resolver health" | devon/irene | short: 24h, long: 3w
- "probe freq 1s -> 250ms (canary)" | "routing debounce window (30s) + min-change threshold" | devon/irene | short: 24h, long: 2w
- "blacklist resolver after 3 SERVFAILs for 60s" | "multi-resolver failover + telemetry" | devon/infra | short: 12h, long: 4w

devon: uploaded pcap and probe logs to incidents bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/3129999999/ and opened infra PR for probe changes.

irene: adding instrumentation task: tag egress traces with resolver_id and affinity_reason so we can correlate user errors to resolver events. ETA 1w.

tess: I'll add the items to the postmortem board and schedule a 10m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm short deploys. If anyone needs to shift ETA, DM me. :thumbsup:
